column1: # Lines typed into TSB Neo 2.60.228 (released CRT) in VICE, as numbered program lines, and the bytes Neo stored
# (line body, hex). Mark: 'fix' = TSB Ultra's tokenizer stores different bytes on purpose (letter index byte
# after $64 not read as a V2 keyword, reports/1.5-tokenizer-collisions.md); 'same' = Ultra must store exactly these.
# Generated 2026-11-11: every TSB keyword x (every V2 keyword, A-Z, ':PRINT 1', ' PRINT 1', '1', ':A=1'), plus one
# line per collision combination and a few realistic forms. Checked by tests/crunch_corpus.py.
